llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create a dedicated runtime with `createWorkletRuntime(...)` and schedule compute onto it with `scheduleOnRuntime(runtime, worklet, ...)`, not deprecated `runOnRuntime`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Uses `useWorklet('default', ...)` which schedules on the default reanimated runtime, not a dedicated runtime created with `createWorkletRuntime`. Neither `createWorkletRuntime` nor `scheduleOnRuntime` appear anywhere in the submitted files.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must bridge runtime results back to React with `scheduleOnRN(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Results are bridged back to React using deprecated `runOnJS(bridgeUpdate)(...)`, not `scheduleOnRN` from `react-native-worklets`. `scheduleOnRN` is never imported or called.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must gate `scheduleOnRN` calls behind an explicit cadence condition (for example modulo/batch checkpoints plus final batch) instead of calling `scheduleOnRN` on every compute iteration.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Bridge calls are gated behind an explicit cadence check: `b % BRIDGE_EVERY_N_BATCHES === 0 || b === TOTAL_BATCHES`, so `runOnJS` (the bridge mechanism used) is only called every 4 batches plus on the final batch, not on every iteration.
evidence: const shouldBridge = b % BRIDGE_EVERY_N_BATCHES === 0 || b === TOTAL_BATCHES
